recipe_order: This is an authored composition of pinned source routines; no installed Compact constructor/geometry dispatcher exists. Do NOT run legacy generator or Manager.Awake: it selects Enlarged80/racks.
Select prospective Compact binding, year0, source model selectors 1/2/2/0 and seed20260914, no clock/random ambient state; reject unavailable profile until future authorisation.
Use exact 175 roster decimals converted to binary32 at source float boundaries, ASCII ID sort. The 14 H1 IDs are absent before any cell/tree-removal event; never spawn then Fell them.
Use fresh tree state recipe, empty management/inventory/protection/deadwood/cohorts; no historical scene actors or donors.
Construct 36 fresh cells with CELL defaults and EC:787-807 coordinate centres; RecomputeCanopy and RecomputeSeedRain from the retained trees only.
Refresh mast unconditionally with EC:777-783 (seed/model/year0), then RecomputeSeedRain. Mast is irrelevant to initial all-zero seed rain because age20<=onset20.
M:2510-2533 EnsureUnderstoreyGrid after final canopy/seed, US.Initially(year0) then UC.Initialize for model2. Do not initialise flora before omissions or during save capture.
Read back every expected value below; do not run annual step/growth/establishment. No dormant ScenarioSiteProfiles.Reference application.

grid.edge: half-open [-15,+15); exact +15 returns -1; closed ground collider surface does not create ecology donor cells

formulas.canopy: EC:822-850,875-885,918: for ASCII-id-sorted living non-stump trees, dx=cx-x,dz=cz-z; distance=sqrt(dx*dx+dz*dz); reach=crown_m*1+2.5; influence=clamp01(clamp01(1-distance/reach)*clamp01(height_m/8)); gap=product(1-influence); canopy=clamp01(1-gap); light=1-canopy.
formulas.flora: US:27-52: L=clamp01(light), site=clamp01(SiteProductivity), stability=clamp01(SoilStability*EstablishmentSuitability), opening=clamp01(recentOpening/2). mosses=clamp01((.45-L)/.45)*site*(.85-.25*opening); ferns=clamp01((L-.06)/.24)*clamp01((.75-L)/.45)*stability*.75; grasses=clamp01((L-.40)/.40)*(.6+.4*opening)*site; forbs=clamp01((L-.32)/.38)*stability*(.55+.45*opening); shrubs=clamp01((L-.50)/.40)*stability*.7; fungi=clamp01(.35+.35*clamp01(canopy))*(.8+.2*site). lastUpdatedYear=0.
formulas.competitors: UC:14-16,24-33: site=clamp01(SiteProductivity*SoilStability); T=.8*site*(.1+(1-.1)*clamp01(light)); brambleCover=brackenCover=T*.25. CompetitionCalibration is fresh source defaults (ScenarioOneCompetition.cs:9). No rate is an empirical measurement.
formulas.seed_rain: EC:1322-1378; TreeSpeciesDefinition.cs:257-264; Species/SitkaSpruce.asset:31-40. Potential=Maturity(age)*clamp01(crown/4)*1*mastMultiplier; sum Potential*exp(-distance/20) within 150m. Maturity(age<=20)=0, full at 30. All 175 are age20: every potential and every seed intensity is exactly 0 regardless of mast. No Oak/Beech donor or external donor exists. EC:1371 writes only positive seedRain, so actual SeedRainBySpecies dictionary remains empty and SeedRainFor(any three species)=0. Model2 creates no legacy empty cohort.
formulas.site: CELL:47-50,240: SiteProductivity=SoilStability=EstablishmentSuitability=1, RecentOpening=0 at fresh construction; accepted source calibration, NOT soil survey. ForestCellSaveData:255-259 persists recentOpening and establishmentSuitability; site productivity/stability are runtime defaults, not new saved fields.
formulas.browse: DEF:56-58 + Manager:441-445: pressure .2 (binary32 readback .20000000298023224), no shelters/fences/protected areas; no juveniles/cohorts to assess, exposure not damage history.
formulas.empty_state: Fresh cells have empty regeneration list (CELL:52); source manager initialises no juvenile/deadwood records (M:620-649); no H1 removal event/RecentOpening is applied.

numeric_policy.arithmetic: IEEE754 binary32 rounding after every scalar source add/sub/mul/div and sqrt; tree input is canonical ROSTER-rounded data, not unrounded C-B-30
numeric_policy.comparison: computed expected readback only, NOT observed; native absolute tolerance 0.000002 for canopy/light/flora/competitors proposed; occupancy/ids/zeros/empties exact
numeric_policy.native_bitwise_parity: NOT VERIFIED: Unity math/compiler/platform must be pinned for bitwise claims
numeric_policy.raw_fixture_canopy_audit_only: provided separately to expose precision difference; MUST NOT substitute for roster-based expected readback

calibration_warning: All flora/site/browse/competitor responses are inherited game calibration and provisional model shapes, not measured Irish ecology.
